versions.changelog: 1.3.2: mechanical length check forces chunking, read the whole skill, translation must be in the reply, leaner chunk loop; README: latest evaluation results
Workflow moved up; full step-by-step (mode, done conditions, self-check, output format, long-text A1–A6); fixes.

Long-text chunking now mandatory above threshold with upfront glossary, 500-800 word chunks, full-document consistency check and optional on-disk working files; full chunked reflection/refine prompts plus glossary-generation prompt; no internal step labels in replies; polish mode returns refined text plus 1-3 key change notes; evals expanded from 3 to 10.
Initial release: three-step (draft → reflection → refine) high-quality translation workflow
